column1: Mod description: Replaces generic book summaries with procedural narratives. Story outline system pre-scans all events to build cast lists, classify narrative arcs, and weave protagonists through earlier chapters. Title analysis drives thematic coherence (celebration, elegy, frontier, mystery, etc). Cross-chapter continuity tracks recurring characters with foreshadowing and incremental updates. Prophecy and lineage systems connect protagonists to events before their birth. Characters react according to personality traits and evolving relationships, with a free-will system that can let events diverge from the planned outline. Reader window includes a Copy Text button. Auto-triggers in adventure mode, overlay button in fortress mode. Requires DFHack.
column2: 以程序化叙事取代通用的书籍摘要。故事大纲系统预先浏览所有事件，建立人物表、划分叙事故事线，并让主角贯穿此前的章节。书名分析让主题保持一致，例如庆颂、挽歌、边疆和谜案。跨章节连续叙事以伏笔和渐进更新追踪反复登场的人物。预言与谱系系统将主角和他们出生前的事件联系起来。人物会根据性格特征与不断变化的关系作出反应；自由意志系统可以让事件偏离预定大纲。阅读窗口内含“复制文本”按钮。冒险模式下自动触发；要塞模式下提供界面叠加按钮。需要 DFHack。

column1: Mod description: Major update covering everything since the last Workshop release. Added a personality/relationship engine: characters now react according to their own traits and their evolving relationship with each other, with a free-will system that can let events diverge from the planned outline (a character can still snap and do something the story never planned). Character entrances and interactions are now properly styled across all three perspectives (Dramatic, Verse, Choreography), not just narrative prose. Massively expanded content variety across mood descriptions, character trait reactions, and argument/dialogue pools to greatly cut down on repeated lines within a single story. Fixed recurring arguments jumping between unrelated topics instead of staying on-subject, essays about other written works losing their content, battle outcomes swapping the winner and loser, and several pronoun/word capitalization bugs. Added a Copy Text button to the book reader window, and cleaned up logging so it no longer spams the DFHack console.
column2: 重大更新，汇集上次创意工坊发布以来的全部改动。加入性格与关系引擎：人物会依据自身特征及彼此不断变化的关系作出反应，自由意志系统允许事件偏离预定大纲，人物仍可能突然失控，做出故事未曾安排的事。人物登场与互动现在正确适配戏剧、诗体和舞蹈编排三个视角，而不再只有普通叙事散文。大幅扩充情绪描写、性格反应、论辩和对话词池，显著减少同一故事中的重复句。修正持续论辩突然转向无关话题、论述其他作品的文章丢失内容、战斗结果颠倒胜败双方，以及多处代词和单词大小写问题。书籍阅读窗口增加“复制文本”按钮，并清理日志，使其不再刷屏 DFHack 控制台。
